subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 25, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - October 25, 2026

Good morning from Spokane! The team has been busy this week pushing improvements across our installer, browser tooling, and core system packages. We are excited to share the latest developments with our growing community of privacy-focused Linux enthusiasts.

Development continues at a steady pace on the Calamares installer configuration with Wayland now forced as the default desktop session for new installations. Darren also resolved a display manager crash by integrating lightdm-slick-greeter, which should provide a much smoother first-boot experience for everyone.

Natalie pushed the initial commit for acreetion-surf version 2.0.0, marking a significant milestone for our custom browser project. The new firefox-fix package has also landed in the community repository, restoring proper window position behavior on Linux systems.

On the infrastructure side, a new lmm-ai project was initialized alongside experimental work on ember-vulkan for enhanced graphics support. The downgrade-desktop utility received a complete rewrite after the previous version encountered screen stability issues, and the new implementation appears to be working well.

Security remains a top priority with Friday's upstream updates from both AlmaLinux and Debian now integrated into our build pipeline. These updates cover critical packages including OpenSSH, PHP variants, Apache, and several system libraries that keep your installations secure.

Our GitLab instance continues to serve as the primary development hub with both Natalie and Darren actively maintaining their respective project namespaces. The Discord community has been particularly helpful in testing the new Wayland defaults and reporting edge cases with various hardware configurations.

For users running the current release, we recommend updating your systems to pull in the latest security patches and the firefox-fix package. The window position restoration works automatically after the next reboot with no configuration required.

If you are planning a fresh installation, the updated Calamares configuration with Wayland-by-default is available in the latest ISO builds on our download page. Darren notes that the lightdm-slick-greeter integration resolves the occasional display manager crash that affected some GPU configurations.

As always, thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS journey. Join us on Discord or GitLab to share feedback, report issues, or just say hello — we are a small team building something we believe in, and every voice helps shape the direction of this project.
